_about: Every device fix GameCove knows. id = folder in fixes/ (kind root / file / power) or an app-level fix (kind app). auto: devices.json ids the installer applies it on (must equal those rows' "fixes" field); optional: ids where the Fixes page offers Apply. "*" = any handheld (the fix itself checks the hardware). password: none (Apply / Undo through gamecove-fix-set, works in Gaming Mode) or admin (gamecove-fix, Desktop Mode). restart: '' | restart | cold-boot | session. page: fixes, or power (shown on the Power page). bazzite / steamos: whether the shipping OS already fixes it (checked 2026-11-08). Research: docs/DEVICE-FIXES.md.

fixes.title: MSI buttons
fixes.line: Makes the two MSI buttons next to the screen work: left opens the menu, right opens Quick Access.
fixes.symptom: Both MSI face buttons do nothing in Gaming Mode: the firmware sends Win+G and F15, InputPlumber's stock map waits for other keys.
fixes.bazzite: Not fixed (InputPlumber still maps the board to claw2).
sources: ClawDeck docs/HARDWARE-FINDINGS.md section 12 (measured with evtest on BIOS E1T91IMS.10D)

fixes.title: Smooth screen down to 30 fps
fixes.line: Lets VRR keep games smooth down to 30 fps instead of 48.
fixes.symptom: The panel's EDID says 48-120 Hz although the panel does 30-120 Hz, so VRR stops working under 48 fps.

fixes.title: Gyro aiming
fixes.line: Turns on the motion sensor so you can aim by tilting the Claw.
fixes.symptom: The Claw 8 EX's IMU sits behind the Intel sensor hub with MSI firmware Linux doesn't load, so there is no gyro.

fixes.title: Volume buttons don't wake it
fixes.line: Stops a bump of the volume buttons from waking the Claw in your bag.
fixes.symptom: The volume buttons are keys on the i8042 keyboard, which is a wakeup source, so pressing them wakes the Claw from sleep.
fixes.bazzite: Not fixed: Handheld Daemon switched it off at start, InputPlumber (Bazzite 44+) doesn't.
fixes.steamos: Not fixed (no Claw support in SteamOS).

fixes.title: Wi-Fi back after sleep
fixes.line: Keeps the Wi-Fi card awake enough to come back after sleep. Uses a little more battery asleep.
fixes.symptom: Wi-Fi is gone after sleep until a restart: the Intel card drops into D3cold and doesn't come back.

fixes.title: Intel AX210 Wi-Fi after sleep
fixes.line: Stops the Intel AX210 Wi-Fi card from crashing after sleep.
fixes.symptom: The AX210 enters D3cold during sleep, iwlwifi can't wake it, Wi-Fi is dead (sometimes even after a restart).
fixes.steamos: Not shipped as far as we can tell; the fix checks the system's own rules.

fixes.title: Sleep that works
fixes.line: Switches off the fingerprint reader, which has no Linux driver and breaks sleep.
fixes.symptom: Suspend/resume is unreliable on the GPD Win 4 and Win Max 2 because of their USB fingerprint readers.
fixes.steamos: Not shipped (GPD isn't a SteamOS device).

fixes.title: Stays asleep
fixes.line: Stops the touch panel from waking the Win Max 2 right after it goes to sleep.
fixes.symptom: The Win Max 2 (2025 especially) wakes again at once: its I2C touch device (PNP0C50:00) is a wakeup source.

fixes.title: Sticks don't wake it
fixes.line: Stops a nudge of the sticks from waking the handheld while it goes to sleep.
fixes.symptom: The built-in controller (0b05:1b4c) is a wakeup source, so stick movement wakes the device before or during sleep.
fixes.steamos: Unknown; the fix checks the system's own rules.

fixes.title: No drain while off
fixes.line: Lets the fingerprint reader power down, so the battery doesn't drain while the Ally is off.
fixes.symptom: The fingerprint reader (1c7a:0588) stays powered and drains the battery even with the Ally switched off.
fixes.steamos: Unknown; the fix checks the system's own rules.

fixes.title: Less drain while asleep
fixes.line: Lets the controller chip power down during sleep. Needs up-to-date MCU firmware.
fixes.symptom: The Ally loses more battery asleep than it needs to while MCU powersave is off.
fixes.bazzite: Handled by Bazzite's own MCU workaround (shows as fixed by the system when on).

fixes.title: Touch in the right place
fixes.line: Makes touch line up with the picture in Gaming Mode (it's turned 90 degrees).
fixes.symptom: gamescope-session-plus marks the F1's sideways panel as external, so gamescope turns the picture but not touch input.
fixes.bazzite: Not fixed (issue 5581; waits for ChimeraOS/gamescope-session PR 128).
fixes.steamos: Not affected the same way (SteamOS uses its own session).

fixes.title: Keep GameCove off the game's cores
fixes.line: While a game runs, GameCove's own work moves to the efficiency cores at low priority.
fixes.symptom: GameCove's background work could land on a performance core next to the game's render thread.
sources: ClawDeck py_modules/clawdeck/quiet.py (same author, measured on the Claw 8 EX 2026-11-04)

fixes.title: Fan presets
fixes.line: Quiet, auto and max fan presets for handhelds whose fan driver has no service.

fixes.title: Charge limit
fixes.line: Stops charging at a limit you choose.
